[# Get the addon](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/rclootcouncil) # Explore your loot history [](https://wow.curseforge.com/projects/rclootcouncil)  # RCLootCouncil Addon

### **RCLootCouncil** is an addon intended to facilitate and speed up the loot council process - something that still exists even though Blizzard has forced Personal Loot upon us all.

## RCLootCouncil Features

### Full awareness

RCLootCouncil comes with a fully automatic interface, allowing your and your council to make decisions that matters.

### Built in lootframe

When a session has started, everyone in the raid can "roll" on the items by simply pressing a button.

### Automated trading

With Personal Loot, trading needs to be done manually - RCLootCouncil makes this a one click affair with the built-in TradeUI. Just get in range (button turns green) and click!

### Session Setup
As the Master Looter/Group Leader you'll be able to see the items that will be added to a session before starting it, and even check how many people have looted the boss.

### Fully customizeable

RCLootCouncil has a ton of options to tailor it specifically to the needs of your group. Just head into the options menu ("/rc config") and have a look!

excerpts: So I was hoping to be able to use the raid icons in some of my addon messages. But they don’t seem to work. I can get colour coded messages working just fine. msg = "|T{rt8}0|t SCARY"; DEFAULT_CHAT_FRAME:AddMessage(msg, r, g, b); Just prints “SCARY”. I also tried without the escape codes and it print “{rt8} SCARY”. So I’m wondering whether the default_chat_frame just flat out won’t work with icons?
